learning_outcomes.text: Developed the ability to apply mathematical/scientific/engineering knowledge.
Instilled a sense of professional responsibility and ethical awareness.
Cultivated the skills to identify, formulate, and solve engineering problems.
Fostered an awareness of the societal and global impacts of engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: General Energy Situation of Türkiye, Importance of Energy Efficiency in Industry
Energy Management Concept, Importance, and Implementation
Energy Management Concept, Importance, and Implementation (Continued)
Energy Efficiency Studies in Industry, Energy Efficiency in Boilers
Energy Efficiency Studies in Industry, Energy Efficiency in Boilers (Continued)
Increasing Energy Efficiency in Steam Systems
Increasing Energy Efficiency in Compressed Air Applications
Increasing Energy Efficiency in Electrical Systems
Increasing Energy Efficiency in Lighting, Cogeneration Applications
Measures to Increase Energy Efficiency in Industry, Preparation of Energy Efficiency Report
Technical Visit to an Energy Efficiency Application Plant
